==Stubs==
Thanks for starting off some new articles! Could you place a stub-marker on them though, if they will need expanding in the future (add <nowiki>{{stub}}</nowiki> at the bottom of the page). That way they will all appear on a special page that shows stub articles. [[User:Aristoc|Aristoc]] 00:10, 9 December 2006 (UTC)

== Redirects ==

I see that you have been making a few pages of the format "See xxx". Rather than doing this, you can use the '''<nowiki>#REDIRECT</nowiki>''' keyword, as I did with [http://wot.wikia.com/index.php?title=Aisling&diff=11672&oldid=11670 the Aisling page]. What this does is that whenever anyone clicks on a link to [[Aisling]], they will be automatically redirected to [[Aisling Noon]]. Try clicking on the link yourself, to see exactly what I mean. --[[User:TheParanoidOne|TheParanoidOne]] 11:44, 10 December 2006 (UTC)
